svg.text: BEN Engine — BEN Node v1 Wiring, Terminal by Terminal — Schreiber AI — IFC Rev A
Olimex ESP32-POE-ISO + BEN-IOB-1 I/O board in a 6-module DIN enclosure · field wiring is Class 2 except relay contacts (Class 1, separate conduit)
IDENT: solid = identify · 1 Hz blink = gateway lost
DS18B20 STRINGS (8 max) · 3-wire CAT5: blue 3V3, white-blue DATA, brown 0V · ≤ 20 m
T_in at rack face (1/3 and 2/3 height) · T_out at rack rear · daisy chain, stubs < 1 m
I²C 0x25 · ±125 Pa · tare with both taps open to the same room
P+ (red tube) → COLD aisle tap P− (blue tube) → HOT aisle tap
3/16 in silicone ≤ 3 m per side · taps flush with containment · no kinks
I²C 0x44 · on the I/O board · vent hole toward the cold aisle · sunshield
ADS1115 (I²C 0x48) is on the I/O board — its inputs are X5 below
loop-powered: 24 V (X2 V+) → transmitter → AI+ · AI− is 0 V
165 Ω 0.1 % shunt per channel on the I/O board (0.66–3.30 V)
ADS1115 gain 1 (±4.096 V), 16-bit → ±0.02 mA after calibration
typical: supply/return water T · flow · CDU pressure · UPS output
shielded twisted pair · shield landed at the node end ONLY
LEAK ROPE · DOOR REED · S0 PULSE · EPO MONITOR
leak rope: 3V3 excitation, 100 k / 10 k divider, HIGH = wet (GPIO36)
door: reed to 0 V, 10 k pull-up, HIGH = open (GPIO39)
pulse: meter S0 output (5–27 V) via opto, 1000 imp/kWh (GPIO34)
EPO / fire panel AUX dry contact → MONITOR ONLY (GPIO35)
EPO wires READ the hardwired loop. They can never open it.
Cat6 shielded ≤ 90 m · shield bonded at the switch · node isolated 3 kV
ALT. POWER 12–24 VDC (if no PoE) · 1 A fuse · reverse-protected
also the 24 V source for the 4–20 mA loops on X5 · 2 A Class 2 supply
drops 60 s after the last gateway contact → unit runs on its own controller
in series with the unit's enable input · 24 V pilot ≤ 1 A · RC snubber 100 Ω / 0.1 µF
COM = supply · NO = load · NC spare
120/230 VAC contactor coil ≤ 5 A · MOV 275 V across the coil
holds last state on gateway loss
COM = supply · NO = load · NC spare
dry contact to the cooling controller DI
holds last state on gateway loss
COM = supply · NO = load · NC spare
24 VDC beacon ≤ 1 A · flyback diode in ULN2003 driver
holds last state on gateway loss
COM = supply · NO = load · NC spare
Relay contacts are Class 1: #14 Cu THHN in their own conduit.
GPIO 32 / 33 / 14 / 15 drive a ULN2003; relays 10 A rated, used ≤ 5 A.
Snubber across every AC load; MOV on every coil.
1. Mount the node on the DIN rail. Bond the rail.
2. Land every shield at the node end only.
3. Plug X3..X7 LAST, after the gateway shows the node online.
4. Tape P+ red and P− blue before routing the tubing.
5. Write unit / node id on the front label.
DIN rail bonded to the panel ground bar (#12 Cu green) · all shields land here
